fields.notes: The M_CAN User's Manual does not specify DFT / scan / BIST insertion — M_CAN ships as VHDL RTL synthesis-ready and DFT is added by the integrator at SoC level. M_CAN does provide rich protocol-level self-checking and built-in test features that substitute for traditional BIST at the protocol level:
spec_provided_built_in_test_features: Loop Back Modes (External + Internal) for hot self-test of the CAN protocol stack — TEST.LBCK = 1.
Bus Monitoring Mode (CCCR.MON = 1) for silent bus traffic analysis.
Restricted Operation Mode (CCCR.ASM = 1) for bit-rate auto-detection without disturbing the bus.
Tx Pin Driver Control (TEST.TX[1:0]) — force dominant / recessive / Sample Point monitor on m_can_tx (production tests).
Rx Pin Monitor (TEST.RX) — read live m_can_rx state.
PSR.TDCV (Transmitter Delay Compensation Value) live readback — verifies SSP positioning per FD frame.
CAN Error Logging Counter ECR.CEL — counts all CAN protocol errors that incremented TEC / REC; reset on read.
RAM Watchdog (RWD) — detects Message RAM no-READY hang.
Access to Reserved Address detection (IR.ARA + m_can_aei_ara) — catches register-map misprogramming.
ECC / parity hooks (m_can_aeim_berr[1:0]) — external ECC reports corrected / uncorrected bit errors in Message RAM; uncorrected sets CCCR.INIT = 1 to prevent transmission of corrupted data.
fields.scan_topology: Not specified — integrator's DFT methodology. Typical SoC-integrated CAN controller IP (e.g. Bosch M_CAN deployed in Renesas RH850, NXP S32, STM32 H7, TI TMS320F28x) inserts standard scan chains at the integrator level + per-domain at-speed test (separate scan modes for m_can_hclk and m_can_cclk domains since they may run at very different frequencies).
fields.atpg_strategy: Not specified — typically full-scan stuck-at + at-speed transition (m_can_cclk domain especially important due to CAN FD high-bit-rate data phase).
